messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Profile | Mining, ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Shilpa,

Mehr Consultancy's executive recruitment work in Saudi Arabia across energy, infrastructure and senior leadership makes this a relevant introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC where responsible growth requires credible institutional engagement, regulatory discipline and stakeholder leadership. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
